title: 4 Hours Tour Beyond the Golden Gate Bridge Marin Headlands and Sausalito
includes: 8.75% environmental fee for carbon offset, gas and tire recycling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore San Francisco with GoCAR’s Electric Vehicle Tour
Discover San Francisco like never before in GoCAR’s GPS-guided EV Sport. Cruise through the scenic Presidio and Crissy Field on your way to the Golden Gate Bridge, then cross into beautiful Sausalito. Snap stunning photos of the Pacific Ocean and the bridge up close. Park and walk the span if you choose! Return via The Presidio and climb Russian Hill for the option to drive down the world-famous Lombard Street. This San Francisco electric car tour lasts about 1.5 hours, with fun detours and photo stops along the way. Extend your adventure with an optional Marin Headlands loop or head back across the Golden Gate for more unforgettable views.
